claim: Try sample data without saving it to your real planner data.
where: landing primary action, demo banner, README, and demo guide
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; assert the bundled scenario, reset behavior, and demo-only storage namespace

claim: The website planner calculates scenarios locally.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; change a scenario, assert the result, and assert no cross-origin request

claim: The website and CLI send no telemetry.
where: landing facts, footer, CLI help, README, and privacy page
sandbox: record browser requests during the complete demo flow and run the CLI demo with unreachable proxy endpoints

claim: Export the current scenario as CSV without a license.
where: planner export button, paid-tier copy, and README
sandbox: fresh demo; download CSV and assert its header and bundled sample row

claim: Read the planner offline after the first visit.
where: connection state, README, and privacy page
sandbox: install and update the service worker online, then reload the demo under offline mode

claim: The CLI demo needs no runtime or network and writes its bundled report to a temporary directory.
where: CLI help, README, and demo guide
sandbox: run the compiled CLI demo without Docker or Podman; parse the printed temporary path and validate its JSON

claim: The CLI refuses production markers by default and enforces the documented workload bounds.
where: landing method, CLI help, README, and terms
sandbox: assert separator-free production names fail; assert the exact maximum succeeds and an over-limit plan fails

claim: The CLI uses an internal labeled network, localhost-only published ports, read-only mounts, and cleans up after success or an ordinary error.
sandbox: run against a deterministic fake Docker executable and inspect every create, run, and cleanup argument

claim: The CLI produces JSON and human reports and compares prediction error against the 25 percent target.
where: landing method, README, and CLI help
sandbox: render and compare the bundled report; assert machine fields, human output, zero error, and the within-25-percent verdict

claim: CLI probe results are written only to the local path the operator requests.
sandbox: run a bounded probe against a local fake runtime, request a temporary output path, and validate the report there

claim: Planner Pro saves the five latest scenarios locally for side-by-side review.
sandbox: mock one valid Sociobot verdict, save six scenarios, and assert only the latest five appear and remain in local storage

claim: License tokens stay in browser storage; manual checks are limited to one per minute and automatic checks to one per day.
where: license form, README, and privacy page
sandbox: mock the documented Sociobot endpoint; assert local token storage, one manual request, local throttling, and no automatic repeat
